title: Ipsum
description: The theme as it comes: a calm, neutral starting point.

title: Backstage
description: Dark stage with neon: spotlight white on black, neon pink accents, tall condensed headings and square buttons. For bands, venues, festivals and DJs.

title: Bold Statement
description: Loud and confident: black and white with a signal red, heavy grotesque headings, square red buttons. For campaigns, agencies and launches.

title: Broadsheet
description: A newspaper look: newsprint white, press black and a masthead red, a bold display serif with a reading serif. For magazines, news and long reads.

title: Clear View
description: High contrast and large type: black on white, strong blue links, a typeface made for legibility, a thick focus border. For public services and accessibility.

title: Corner Café
description: Cozy and warm: espresso and terracotta on latte, a friendly serif with a clean sans. For cafés, bakeries, delis and neighborhood shops.

title: Crayon Box
description: Bright and easy to read: crayon blue on chalk white, big rounded type, large pill buttons. For schools, nurseries, children's books and family events.

title: Fjord
description: Nordic and minimal: granite on snow, a cool fjord blue, a tidy geometric pair and small radii. For architects, design studios, consultancies and travel.

title: Forest Floor
description: Earthy and warm: moss and bark on recycled paper, a soft wonky serif and rounded fern buttons. For gardens, farms, outdoor and eco projects.

title: Gallery White
description: A white cube: graphite on white, an ultramarine accent, an expressive display face and thin outlined buttons, very wide. For portfolios, artists and studios.

title: Grand Salon
description: Quiet luxury: ivory, umber and antique gold, a high-contrast Garamond and thin outlined buttons. For hotels, jewelers, weddings and fine dining.

title: Harbour
description: Nautical and crisp: navy on sea spray with a signal red and brass, a sturdy slab serif. For marinas, sailing clubs, coastal towns and seafood.

title: Jukebox
description: Retro diner fun: cola brown on malt cream, a rust red and mustard, a looping script and pill buttons with a hard shadow. For bars, vintage shops, events.

title: Margin Notes
description: A writer's notebook: ink on paper, one book typeface for everything, a narrow reading column and outlined buttons. For writers, essays and long reads.

title: Market Street
description: Clean and trustworthy for selling: charcoal on white, a shop green for buttons, rounded corners and a soft shadow. For shops, menus and price lists.

title: Midnight Ink
description: Elegant and dark: parchment text on midnight blue, gold leaf accents, a fine display serif and outlined gold buttons. For evening events, wine bars and authors.

title: Night Shift
description: Dark and technical: frost text on midnight, cyan accents, monospaced headings. For developers, documentation, SaaS and tech blogs.

title: Open Hands
description: Warm and hopeful: slate on warm white with an ember orange for calls to action, a sturdy serif. For charities, associations, appeals and volunteers.

title: Playground
description: Cheerful and round: indigo text, magenta pill buttons and sunny extras. For events, hobby clubs, kids' activities and fun brands.

title: Quiet Room
description: Gentle and restful: dusk and plum on linen, a calm serif with a rounded sans, soft pill buttons. For yoga, wellness, spas and mindful living.

title: Still Water
description: Calm and airy: sage greens on a misty white, a soft serif for headings. For coaches, therapists, small studios and quiet blogs.
